title: Quick Melted Syrian Sausage Wrap
description: A malty, cheese-pull, midnight-craving Syrian dish featuring Italian fennel sausages and ssam-wrap, sugar-free-friendly.

ingredients.name: Italian fennel sausages
ingredients.notes: sweet Italian sausage with fennel seeds

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Brush the ssam-wrap with olive oil on both sides.
Grill the Italian fennel sausages until browned and cooked through.
Grill the ssam-wrap for 30 seconds on each side.
Assemble the wrap by slicing the sausage and placing it on the tortilla.
Top the sausage with mozzarella cheese, caramelized onions, and sumac.
Fold the bottom half of the tortilla up over the filling.
Fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Place the wrap under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
